name: Everyday Checking
tagline: Free checking with no minimum balance
summary: No monthly fee, no minimum balance, and a debit card that works at 30,000 surcharge-free ATMs.
highlights:
No monthly service fee
No minimum balance
Early direct deposit, up to two days
Free checks for members 60 and older
body:
Everyday Checking is the account most members start with. There is no monthly fee and no minimum balance, and you can see and move your money in the mobile app.

What you get

  • A Visa debit card with card controls in the app
  • Surcharge-free withdrawals at our ATMs and 30,000 network ATMs
  • Mobile check deposit and free bill pay
  • Overdraft protection by transfer from your savings, at no charge

How to open it

Visit any branch with a photo ID. If you are not a member yet, you will open a share savings account with $5 at the same time.

name: Dividend Checking
summary: Earns dividends on balances over $2,500, with ATM fee refunds up to $15 a month.
highlights:
Dividends on balances over $2,500
ATM fee refunds up to $15 a month
No fee with $2,500 average balance
body: Dividend Checking pays dividends on your whole balance when your average daily balance is $2,500 or more. Below that, there is a $6 monthly fee.

name: Share Savings
summary: The $5 in this account is your share of ownership in Kestrel Valley.
highlights:
$5 opens it and makes you a member
Dividends paid monthly
One vote at the annual meeting
body: Every member has a Share Savings account. The $5 minimum is your share of ownership in the credit union, and it gives you one vote in board elections, no matter how much you have on deposit.

name: Money Market
summary: Tiered dividends that rise with your balance, and up to six withdrawals a month.
highlights:
Tiered dividends
No fee with $1,000 balance
Write up to six checks a month
body: A Money Market account pays more as your balance grows, and you can still move money when you need it.

name: Certificates
summary: Fixed rates from 6 months to 5 years. Add to a 12-month certificate any time.
highlights:
Terms from 6 to 60 months
$500 minimum
IRA certificates available
body: Certificates pay a fixed dividend for a set term. The 12-month Add-On certificate lets you add deposits during the term. An early withdrawal penalty applies.

name: New and used auto loans
summary: Rates as low as 5.49% APR, terms up to 84 months, and no payment for 60 days.
highlights:
Terms up to 84 months
Refinance from another lender
GAP and payment protection available
body: Our auto loans cover new and used cars, trucks and motorcycles from a dealer or a private seller. Ask any branch for a preapproval before you shop, so you know your budget.

name: Home loans
summary: Fixed and adjustable mortgages made and serviced right here in the valley.
highlights:
Local underwriting and servicing
First-time buyer program with 3% down
Construction-to-permanent loans
body: Our mortgage team in Harlow underwrites and services every loan we make. Your payment goes to us, not to a servicer three states away.

name: Home equity line of credit
summary: A revolving line for renovations or big expenses, with interest-only draw period.
highlights:
Borrow up to 85% of your home's value
No closing costs on lines up to $250,000
10-year draw, 15-year repayment
body: A home equity line of credit lets you borrow what you need, when you need it, and pay interest only on what you use.

name: Personal loans
summary: Fixed-rate loans from $1,000 to $40,000 for repairs, medical bills or consolidating debt.
highlights:
Fixed rate and payment
No prepayment penalty
Decision in one business day
body: A personal loan gives you a fixed rate and a fixed payment, so you know when it will be paid off.

name: Visa Platinum card
summary: One low rate on purchases, balance transfers and cash advances, with no annual fee.
highlights:
No annual fee
No balance transfer fee for the first 90 days
Card controls in the app
body: The Visa Platinum card keeps things simple: one rate, no annual fee and no rewards points to track.

name: Business checking and loans
summary: Checking, lines of credit and equipment loans from lenders who know the valley.
highlights:
Free business checking up to 300 items
Lines of credit and equipment loans
SBA loans through our Copper Flats team
body: Our business services team in Copper Flats works with farms, shops, contractors and nonprofits across the valley.
